fatal_errors: The initial material is incorrectly described as a single-phase FCC alloy; the target as-deposited films and nanoribbons are amorphous or extremely fine/disordered, with only cubic-type short-range order.

No single controlled intervention is specified. Simultaneously varying unspecified compositions and processing conditions cannot distinguish among composition, structural relaxation, strain, and geometry effects.

The proposed Mn-frustration and exchange-energy-distribution mechanism does not reconstruct the target mechanism of annealing-induced short-range reordering and internal-strain relaxation, magnetoelastic response, and spacing-dependent inter-ribbon coupling.
The cited evidence concerns materially different HEA families and does not establish the proposed mechanism in Fe25Ni21Mn24Si13Ge17 thin films or nanoribbons.
The prediction lacks measurable temperature, field, strain, annealing, and geometry bounds and provides no quantitative comparison with the as-deposited baseline.
The falsification rule invokes a 10% deviation from unspecified predicted values, making it arbitrary and operationally unusable.
explanation: The response broadly recognizes rare-earth-free HEA magnetocalorics and the possible importance of magnetic heterogeneity, but it does not recover the experimentally relevant thin-film/nanoribbon system or its governing variables. A discriminating reconstruction would control one variable—most directly 700 K annealing of 1 µm-spaced nanoribbons—and test whether magnetization and the 140 K entropy-change maximum increase despite TEM/SAED showing no crystallization. That outcome would support short-range atomic relaxation and reduced pinning rather than an FCC phase or composition-driven explanation. The response instead proposes an open-ended composition-and-processing survey, gives only generic improvement predictions, omits the elastic-strain and ribbon-spacing boundaries, and supplies no meaningful hysteresis-cycle test. Its external citations lend generic plausibility to exchange disorder and Mn frustration but are not valid evidence for the stated material-specific claim.
